items.briefing:
Australian edtech platform Mathspace has suffered a significant data breach affecting more than one million students, parents, and teachers. Personal information held by the platform has been exposed, making this directly relevant to schools and training organisations across Australia that may use the service. If your organisation or staff have accounts with Mathspace, assume your details may be compromised.

If you or anyone you know uses Mathspace, change your password immediately and watch for suspicious emails or messages that may use your personal details to appear legitimate. As a general habit, never reuse the same password across multiple accounts.
